# Go to Directory: the palette's Folders — a path typed lists where it leads
# (Return: a new tab there), and where shells have been is listed after.
type:mkdir -p @DIR@/sub-alpha @DIR@/sub-beta
key:enter
wait:0.8
action:go_to_directory
wait:0.5
expect-scope:[Folders]
type:@DIR@/sub-al
wait:0.4
expect-palette:sub-alpha
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-tab-count:2
expect-tab:sub-alpha
# Where a shell has been (OSC 7) is listed after, without typing it — once it has
# moved on too (only the recent folders know it then).
type:cd @DIR@/sub-beta
key:enter
wait:2.0
# (Its prompt reported it: recorded before the shell moves on.)
expect-tab:sub-beta
type:cd /
key:enter
wait:2.0
action:go_to_directory
wait:0.5
type:beta
wait:0.4
expect-palette:sub-beta
key:escape
wait:0.3
# A path typed with its slash: that folder first, then what's in it.
action:go_to_directory
wait:0.5
type:@DIR@/
wait:0.4
expect-palette:folders · new tab here
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-tab-count:3
